title: Stability Regularized Cross-Validation
abstract: arXiv:2505.06927v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study hyperparameter selection via cross-validation, motivated by settings in which the selected $k$-fold cross-validation error underestimates the selected model's test error. We propose a nested $k$-fold cross-validation scheme that minimizes a weighted sum of the standard cross-validation error and empirical hypothesis stability, with the stability weight selected by an outer cross-validation loop. We derive a generalization bound that controls test error using the cross-validation error and empirical hypothesis stability, together with correction terms common to every candidate. In a stylized ridge regression setting, we then show that whether the stability weight improves expected test-set performance depends on the signal-to-noise ratio, with the greatest improvement when the signal-to-noise ratio is small. On $13$ real-world regression datasets, the procedure reduces the average out-of-sample MSE relative to $k$-fold

translated_title: 稳定性正则化交叉验证
translated_abstract: 我们研究通过交叉验证进行超参数选择的问题，其动机源于这样的场景：所选模型的 k 折交叉验证误差会低估该模型的测试误差。我们提出了一种嵌套的 k 折交叉验证方案，该方案最小化标准交叉验证误差与经验假设稳定性的加权和，其中稳定性权重由外层交叉验证循环来选择。我们推导出了一个泛化界，利用交叉验证误差和经验假设稳定性（以及每个候选模型共有的修正项）来控制测试误差。在一个简化的岭回归设定中，我们进一步表明，稳定性权重能否提升期望测试集性能取决于信噪比，当信噪比较小时提升效果最为显著。在 13 个真实世界的回归数据集上，该程序相比 k 折交叉验证降低了平均样本外 MSE。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种嵌套 k 折交叉验证方案，通过最小化标准交叉验证误差与经验假设稳定性的加权和来选择超参数，并证明了由此得到的泛化界，显示在信噪比较低的场景下该方法对测试误差的改善最为显著。
